_comment: Launch data for one runtime (design D37-RUNTIME-1: engine code holds no runtime name). Only the fields the session launcher and graceful close need; full runtime profiles come later (tasks.md 19.1). In argv lists, {session_id}, {model} and {title} are filled in by the engine; {prompt} becomes the prompt file's text when the session starts.

transcript._comment: Where a session's transcript is found by its session ID (H-090). root_env names the variable that moves the folder (account environment first, then the launch environment); root_default is used otherwise, with {home} for HOME. glob is relative to the root.
